transcript: Stop eating these three things in the morning and you'll see how your day becomes lighter, calmer and better. In Chinese medicine, the morning is when your body's energy is soft and delicate. Whatever you consume in that first hour shapes your mood, your focus, and even your emotional balance for the rest of the day. In the East, we say, the morning is the first breath of the day. If you burden it, you burden the entire day. Here are three things your body quietly asks you to avoid. First, coffee on an empty stomach. When you wake up, your digestive fire is still weak. Coffee burns through it, spikes cortisol, creates tension, and leads to energy crashes later. Start with warm water. Let your body wake up first, then have your coffee, simple sugars and pastries. Second, sweet cereals, croissants, cookies. This is fast fire, a quick spike followed by a hard crash. It leaves you tired, foggy, and craving more. Third, very cold foods, icy smoothies, cold yogurt, drinks with ice, cold weakens digestion, and slows the entire system down, making your morning feel heavy instead of clear. In the East, the morning is like a sunrise. If you begin it warm and gentle, the entire day follows the same way. If you're ready to reset your body and mind the right way. I created a 30-day healing journey that walks you step by step. Follow and comment healing below. I'll send you the way to begin.
